verdict.rationale: Fly.io's first-party material directly claims this story. It describes running code "in a hardware-isolated VM" with "a clean baseline per request" that is "egress-locked and disposable", and describes Fly Machines as hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second and can be driven via a REST API and `fly machine run`. Sprites add per-agent isolated boxes with egress policy and checkpoint rollback. missing for 10: in-depth technical documentation of the isolation mechanism and its untrusted-code threat model, independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox isolation and disposability.
